title: docs: add a sequence diagram for the escrow withdrawal to the README
body:
### Context

The README shows the lifecycle as text. A Mermaid sequence diagram (wallet → backend → escrow → rail → claim) would help new contributors understand escrow mode quickly.

### Scope

**Files:** `README.md`

Add a `sequenceDiagram` under "Transaction lifecycles" covering: SEP-24 withdraw with `withdraw_mode=escrow`, the wallet's `deposit` call, the `locked` event, the payout, `claim`, and the failure branch (`cancel` → `refunded`). Use the exact names from `src/sep24/service.ts`.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Diagram renders on GitHub
- [ ] Names match the code (statuses, functions, events)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: test: cover the SEP-10 memo (ID memo) flow end to end
body:
### Context

SEP-10 accepts a numeric `memo` for shared accounts. The JWT `sub` becomes `G...:memo`, and deposits must be paid with an **ID memo**. No test covers this path.

### Scope

**Files:** `test/sep10.test.ts`, `test/e2e-sandbox.test.ts`

Add tests that (1) request a challenge with `memo=12345` and check the JWT `sub`, (2) reject a non-numeric memo, and (3) run a deposit with that token and assert `FakeStellarGateway.sent[0].memo === "12345"` and `deposit_memo_type === "id"`.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Three new assertions pass
- [ ] No production code changes needed (or they're explained in the PR)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat: expire abandoned transactions (incomplete / pending_user_transfer_start → expired)
body:
### Context

Transactions a user never finishes stay `incomplete` or `pending_user_transfer_start` forever. SEP-24 has an `expired` status for this, and the state machine already allows it.

### Scope

**Files:** `src/sep24/service.ts`, `src/server.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `src/store/*`, `test/`

Add a periodic job (`EXPIRE_AFTER_MINUTES`, default 24h) that moves stale transactions to `expired` via `transition()` with actor `expiry-job`. Escrow withdrawals whose lock was already seen must not expire. Add a store query for stale transactions.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Stale deposits and standard withdrawals become `expired` with an audit entry
- [ ] Escrow withdrawals with a lock are untouched
- [ ] Tests use fake timers; store contract test covers the query
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(sep24): support SEP-24 `claimable_balance_supported` for deposits without a trustline
body:
### Context

If a wallet has no USDC trustline, the deposit payment fails and goes to `error`. SEP-24 lets wallets pass `claimable_balance_supported=true` so the anchor sends a claimable balance instead.

### Scope

**Files:** `src/sep24/routes.ts`, `src/stellar/gateway.ts`, `src/sep24/service.ts`, `src/sep24/serialize.ts`, `test/`

Store the flag. When paying a deposit, check the trustline (`StellarGateway`). If it's missing and the flag is set, create a claimable balance and set `claimable_balance_id` on the transaction. Without the flag, use `pending_trust` and retry when the trustline appears.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both branches tested with the fake gateway
- [ ] `/info` advertises `features.claimable_balances: true`
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

### Complexity

Medium (150 points)

title: feat(escrow): retry failed claims before expiry
body:
### Context

If `claim` fails after the fiat payout (RPC outage, fee spike), the transaction goes to `error` and the anchor risks the user refunding after expiry. It has paid, but can't collect.

### Scope

**Files:** `src/sep24/service.ts`, `src/escrow/watcher.ts`, `src/sep24/state.ts`, `test/escrow.test.ts`

Keep such transactions in `pending_stellar` with a retry count and next-attempt time, and retry `claim` with backoff from the watcher loop until N attempts or `expires_ledger - margin`, then go to `error`. Record each attempt in the audit note.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A transient claim failure recovers to `completed`
- [ ] Persistent failure ends in `error` before expiry
- [ ] Tests use SandboxEscrowGateway.failClaim
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

### Complexity

Medium (150 points)

title: feat: SEP-38 quotes for firm exchange rates
body:
### Context

USDC is pegged to USD, but fees and future non-USD corridors need firm quotes. SEP-24 accepts a `quote_id` from SEP-38.

### Scope

**Files:** `src/sep38/ (new)`, `src/sep24/routes.ts`, `src/sep24/service.ts`, `src/store/schema.ts`, `test/`

Implement SEP-38 `/info`, `/prices`, `/price` and `POST/GET /quote` for `iso4217:USD` ⇄ `stellar:USDC` with a configurable spread. Honour `quote_id` in SEP-24 requests: lock amounts to the quote and reject expired quotes.

title: feat(escrow): index escrow events into a queryable table
body:
### Context

The watcher only acts on events for known transactions. Support and audits need every escrow event (including unknown `tx_id`s, admin events and upgrades) stored and queryable.

### Scope

**Files:** `src/escrow/watcher.ts`, `src/escrow/soroban.ts`, `src/store/schema.ts`, `drizzle/`, `src/admin/ or src/sandbox/`, `test/`

Add an `escrow_events` table (id, ledger, tx hash, type, tx_id, decoded data JSON). Decode admin events too (`paused_changed`, `anchor_updated`, `upgraded`), store every event idempotently by RPC event id, and alert (log at error) on `upgraded` or `anchor_updated`. Expose a read endpoint for operators.

### Acceptance criteria
